scripts.//-- setup --: One-time bootstrap after a fresh clone. Needs Docker running.
scripts.//-- dev --: Local stack. Supabase on 54421-54429 — offset +100 so it coexists with project-running's stack on 54321-54327.
scripts.//-- test --: Deno unit tests for edge functions and ingest adapters; pgTAP for schema, FIFO derivation and RLS.
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:mobile && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:backend: pnpm run test:backend:unit && pnpm run test:backend:db
scripts.check: pnpm run check:backend && pnpm run check:unions && pnpm run check:mobile && pnpm run check:web
scripts.//-- gen --: Regenerate database.types.ts from the live local schema. Commit the result.
scripts.//-- web --: SvelteKit 5 static SPA on port 7777. dev:run:web needs dev:core up first — it reads the publishable key from `supabase status` and never writes it to a file.
scripts.//-- ai --: Local LLM behind the research assistant. Ollama on 11434; AI_PROVIDER defaults to it, so no cloud key is needed. Model from AI_MODEL (default llama3.2). See docs/STACK.md § The AI research assistant.
